levels.slot: 19 (act 3, third house; after level21 The Catwalk, before level22 Skeletons in the Closet)
levels.body: floor_lamp (the only lamp level of act 3; level16 is cut)
levels.main_threat: Range, not timing. Maman (watchful, dark range 4.0 m Normal / 4.6 m Difficile) paces a 4.5 m stretch of the corridor, always facing east toward the kitchen door; Papa (dreamer, dark range 3.2 m / 3.68 m) walks bathroom -> kitchen table -> fridge -> bed and opens the kitchen door; Rex (dog, dark range 2.4 m / 2.76 m) commutes from his bed in the entree to the salon. Switched off, the lamp is safe beyond each watcher's dark range, so the player waits for distance, not for a head turn.
levels.plan_shape: A ring of three lanes off one long corridor (room shells unchanged): bureau (start) -> corridor -> porte_cuisine (only Papa opens it) -> kitchen -> new salon gap -> salon (exit). The corridor-west lane into the salon is closed by porte_salon, 1 m from Maman's west post (level 16's trap door). The kitchen-entree side room holds Rex's bed.
levels.exit_direction: West-south-west: spawn (10.25, 9.75) in the bureau, doormat (0.75, 1.25) at a new garden door in the salon's west wall. Today it exits east like 22 of 24 levels; both neighbours (21, 22) exit east.
levels.look: Night: slate-blue and dusty-blue walls (arches, grasscloth), dark oak herringbone floors, tile kitchen, no secondary light in the corridor and the entree (lightWall none) so light pools where people are. Real night lighting (moon key, dark ambient) is code.
levels.twist: A door only Dad opens (porte_cuisine) next to a door you must not open (porte_salon, beside Maman, and the household remembers doors). With the lit-zone code: the study light left on spills into the corridor in front of the bureau door, the one place where being switched off does not help.
levels.lesson: The dark range as a ruler. Being switched off turns each watcher's cone into a short radius (4.0 / 3.2 / 2.4 m), so the player reads how far each person is, not where they look. Act 3's only lamp level and its only level with neither a wardrobe nor a mezzanine.

levels.targets: Normal: earliest exit 48 to 62 s (today 55.3 s), route 18 to 22 m (today 26.5 m); waiting 25 to 40 % with the toggle counted as waiting (today 5 %); at least 4 pauses of 0.5 s or more, at least 3 of them mid-route, none above 6 s (audit longest wait at most 6.5 s); exactly 1 toggle in designerRoute (or the audit code fix). Difficile: exit 3 to 10 s later than Normal (Maman's 4.6 m and Rex's 2.76 m must change the schedule). Lesson dark binds with no advisory; the route passes the kitchen door front while Maman is 3.5 to 4.6 m away at M2 (check with -debugSamples around that time); the route enters the kitchen through porte_cuisine after Papa opened it and never opens porte_salon (test Level20Lesson: toggles >= 1, player door opens 0, household opens >= 1); every room holds a station or a route cell (bureau spawn, couloir, cuisine, salon exit, entree Rex, sdb Papa, chambre Papa); margin at least 0.3 s early and late; -slack maximum margin 4 to 8 samples; budgets at most 160 draw calls and 32 materials (expect about 120 / 24 after removing 3 wardrobes).
risks: Human separation: Papa's P2 -> P3 walk from the kitchen doorway (9.25, 4.95) to the chambre door (3.25, 6.95) passes about 0.87 m from M2 (5.75, 5.25) while Maman paces at z 5.25. Dark binding: it relies on Maman's back-turned window (about 5.3 s) being shorter than the lit crossing from the bureau doorway into the kitchen (about 4.15 m, 7.5 s). If 'lamp always on' still finds a schedule, shorten her M1 <-> M2 walk or lengthen her dwells facing east.

Switch-on rule: a watcher who sees the dark lamp at its home walks over and switches it on. Spawn (10.25, 9.75) is 4.37 m from the nearest corridor point with a line through the bureau doorway, above Papa's 3.68 m Difficile dark range; do not move the spawn closer to the door.

Rex walks through the kitchen while the lamp waits there. The dog sees only movement, so the lamp can freeze, but inhabitants walk through furniture (IDEAS bug 1): keep the lamp's kitchen waiting cells at z 3.75 or more (Rex walks near z 1.75).

Deviation from the review: it asks to narrow the corridor so the path passes inside Maman's dark range. Width does not change distance: today Maman stands at the corridor's east end (17.25, 5.75) facing west and the route uses only x <= 9.25 of the corridor, 8 m away. The lever is her position, so she now paces between x 1.25 and 5.75.

Deviation from the review: the 'ring around the corridor' becomes a ring of lanes through the kitchen and the salon, closed on the corridor side by porte_salon; I did not add chambre <-> bureau or bureau <-> sdb doors because a bureau <-> sdb door would route Papa through the spawn room (switch-on) and a chambre door would let the solver skip the kitchen, the obstacle in the title.

notes: Group act3b: slot 19 = level20 Midnight Munchies (rebuild on the same room shells), slot 20 = level22 Skeletons in the Closet (fix). LENGTH: neither level gets longer in metres. PRD 1.3's 2 to 6 minutes can only mean a first clear with retries: a 6-minute clean route would break the 8 s wait cap or become a walk. Targets at Normal: strict exit about 48 to 62 s (level20, route cut from 26.5 m to about 20 m) and 50 to 65 s (level22, about 31 m), 25 to 40 % waiting in 4 to 6 pauses of at most 6 s. That is 4 to 6 decisions each worth a retry, aiming at a 3 to 5 minute first clear. The relaxed check (feedback R1b) is still to be built.
